summary: PennantPark Private Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting a routine unregistered sale of 32,047 common shares on September 1, 2026, at roughly $25.90 per share for aggregate consideration of about $830,000, under its continuous private offering to accredited investors via Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. The filing also discloses an August 31, 2026 NAV per share of $25.90 and aggregate NAV of approximately $129,455,769. No premium, advisor, board recommendation, or change-of-control terms are stated. This is an ordinary private-placement capital raise, not a special situation; watch for continued NAV-accretive subscriptions.
